Paani Earth, Cauvery Basin GIS package (Aug 2026): named river centrelines, clipped to the Karnataka basin share. No centreline yet for the Palar (layer ships empty), Bhavani or Chinnar (the package's lines follow their Tamil Nadu courses, outside the Karnataka share).

India-WRIS major waterbodies register for the Cauvery basin, as delivered in Paani Earth's Cauvery snapshot layer package (Aug 2026); clipped to the Karnataka basin share. Areas are the register's own area_ha.

Paani Earth, Cauvery Basin GIS package (Aug 2026): Greater Bengaluru Authority boundary, split by the Cauvery basin divide. Used as geometry only - the source carries ward-level census columns, but the two parts are geometry clips of one ward set, so ward populations cannot be summed across the split without double-counting.
